    "candidate_feature_io.py": "e7c26202f02ba870e0a2db9cb840ab64c706929efe98da111b405ce4ffb47321",
}
def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name, expected in pins.items():
    actual = digest(root / name)
    if actual != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"Source or receiver identity mismatch: {name}: {actual}")
if (root / "windows-qualification.json").exists():
    raise SystemExit("Qualification already completed; inspect its receipt")
environment = dict(os.environ)
environment["TEMP"] = str(root / "temp")
environment["TMP"] = str(root / "temp")
runs = {}
for role in ["original", "candidate"]:
    source = root / (role + "_feature_io.py")
    receipt = root / (role + "-windows-receipt.json")
    command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(root / "receive_sidecar.py"), str(source),
               "--expected-sha256", pins[source.name], "--output", str(receipt)]
    run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    (root / (role + "-windows.log")).write_text(run.stdout + run.stderr, encoding="utf-8")

                          "checks_total": sum(len(case["checks"]) for case in data["cases"]),
                          "platform": data["platform"], "python": data["python"], "pandas": data["pandas"], "pyarrow": data["pyarrow"],
                          "source_unchanged": data["source_unchanged"], "fixtures_removed": data["all_owned_fixtures_removed"]})
after = {name: digest(root / name) for name in pins}

    "receiver_author": "chatgpt-f0f66340f637/runtime_integration",

    "receiver_unchanged": True,
    "scope": "Exact existing five-case real Pandas/PyArrow writer receiver executed on native Windows CPython3.12.10. This is a new platform run of the prior receiver, not a newly blinded test design.",
    "qualification_note": "The reused child receipts retain their original actor and native_windows_acceptance:false field verbatim. This wrapper attributes actual Windows execution separately and does not waive full analysis, Ruff, GUI, CI, installed or hardware gates.",

import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, zipfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = pathlib.Path(r"D:\CaptureSuite-receiving-7cb7e049e2c0")
runtime = root / "python312"
temporary = root / "temp"
temporary.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
archive = source / "python-3.12.10-embed-amd64.zip"
pip_source = source / "pip-26.2.1.pyz"
archive_bytes = archive.read_bytes()
pip_bytes = pip_source.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(archive_bytes).hexdigest() == "4acbed6dd1c744b0376e3b1cf57ce906f9dc9e95e68824584c8099a63025a3c3"
assert hashlib.md5(archive_bytes).hexdigest() == "fe8ef205f2e9c3ba44d0cf9954e1abd3"
assert hashlib.sha256(pip_bytes).hexdigest() == "91d5fd9f6f25549fd839c60536c6f1b945316ce3588d34a605635b6071c91526"
if runtime.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Owned interpreter already exists; inspect the recorded setup rather than repeating it")
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
    z.extractall(runtime)
(runtime / "python312._pth").write_text("python312.zip\n.\nsite-packages\nimport site\n", encoding="utf-8")
pip_local = root / "pip-26.2.1.pyz"
pip_local.write_bytes(pip_bytes)
receiving_environment = dict(os.environ)
receiving_environment["TEMP"] = str(temporary)
receiving_environment["TMP"] = str(temporary)
requirements = ["numpy==2.3.5", "pandas==2.2.3", "pyarrow==26.0.0"]
command = [str(runtime / "python.exe"), "-B", str(pip_local), "--isolated", "install",
           "--disable-pip-version-check", "--only-binary=:all:", "--no-cache-dir",
           "--target", str(runtime / "site-packages"), "--report", str(root / "dependency-report.json")] + requirements
print(json.dumps({"started": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "runtime": str(runtime),
                  "requirements": requirements, "source_python_archive_sha256": hashlib.sha256(archive_bytes).hexdigest(),
                  "source_pip_sha256": hashlib.sha256(pip_bytes).hexdigest(), "free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage(root).free}), flush=True)
with (root / "setup-runtime.log").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=receiving_environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=480)
        receipt = {"status": "complete" if result.returncode == 0 else "failed", "returncode": result.returncode}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        receipt = {"status": "timeout", "returncode": None}
receipt.update({"finished": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "command": command, "runtime": str(runtime),
                "requirements": requirements, "root": str(root), "owned_temp": str(temporary)})
(root / "setup-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if receipt["status"] == "complete" else 1)

import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, urllib.parse
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
report = json.loads((root / "dependency-report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
wheel_dir = root / "temp" / "pip-unpack-tdmx9_8n"
records = []
for item in report["install"]:
    wheel = wheel_dir / pathlib.PurePosixPath(urllib.parse.urlparse(item["download_info"]["url"]).path).name
    actual = hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    expected = item["download_info"]["archive_info"]["hashes"]["sha256"]
    if actual != expected:
        raise SystemExit("Downloaded wheel mismatch: " + wheel.name)
    records.append({"name": item["metadata"]["name"], "version": item["metadata"]["version"], "wheel":wheel.name, "sha256":actual})
target = root / "python312" / "site-packages"
if target.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Target is present; inspect before any subsequent installation")
temporary = root / "temp-no-compile"
temporary.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
environment = dict(os.environ)
environment["TEMP"] = str(temporary)
environment["TMP"] = str(temporary)
command = [str(root / "python312" / "python.exe"), "-B", str(root / "pip-26.2.1.pyz"),
           "--isolated", "install", "--disable-pip-version-check", "--no-index",
           "--find-links", str(wheel_dir), "--only-binary=:all:", "--no-cache-dir", "--no-compile",
           "--target", str(target)] + [r["name"] + "==" + r["version"] for r in records]
print(json.dumps({"stage":"offline-no-compile-install","started":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"verified_wheels":records}),flush=True)
with (root / "offline-install.log").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
    try:
        run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=240)
        result = {"status":"complete" if run.returncode==0 else "failed","returncode":run.returncode}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        result = {"status":"timeout","returncode":None}
result.update({"finished":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"verified_wheels":records,"command":command,"original_timeout_preserved":True})
(root / "offline-install-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if result["status"]=="complete" else 1)

"""Independent actual-file receiving of CaptureSuite CSV sidecar placement."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import sys
import tempfile

import pandas as pd
import pyarrow

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def receive_case(module, temp_parent, name, relative, sentinel):
    frame = pd.DataFrame({"frame": [0, 1], "subject": ["alpha \u03b1", "beta \u03b2"],
                          "score": [0.5, 2.0], "present": [True, False]}, index=[71, 9])
    frame_before = frame.copy(deep=True)
    metadata = [{"name": c, "dtype": str(frame[c].dtype), "unit": "fixture"} for c in frame.columns]
    metadata_before = copy.deepcopy(metadata)
    outputs_before = [{"relativePath": "keep.dat", "bytes": 4, "sha256": sha(b"KEEP"), "kind": "retained"}]
    outputs = copy.deepcopy(outputs_before)
    schema_before = {"tables": {"retained.parquet": {"rows": 8}}, "retained_extension": {"keep": True}}
    schema = copy.deepcopy(schema_before)
    normal = relative.replace("\\", "/")
    assert normal.endswith(".parquet")
    expected_csv = normal[:-8] + ".csv"
    incorrect_csv = normal.replace(".parquet", ".csv")
    sentinel_bytes = b"prior,unrelated\nkeep,this.csv\n"
    checks = {}
    error = None
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=name + "-", dir=temp_parent) as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        (root / "keep.dat").write_bytes(b"KEEP")
        if sentinel:
            assert incorrect_csv != expected_csv
            p = root / incorrect_csv
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            p.write_bytes(sentinel_bytes)
        try:
            returned = module.write_feature_table(root, relative, frame,
                feature_schema_version=7, columns_meta=metadata, schema_doc=schema, outputs=outputs)
            checks["returns-none-without-error"] = returned is None
        except Exception as exc:
            error = {"type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}
            checks["returns-none-without-error"] = False
        parquet_path, csv_path = root / normal, root / expected_csv
        checks["parquet-and-colocated-csv-exist"] = parquet_path.is_file() and csv_path.is_file()
        parquet_read = csv_read = False
        decode_errors = []
        if parquet_path.is_file():
            try:
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(pd.read_parquet(parquet_path), frame.reset_index(drop=True), check_exact=True)
                parquet_read = True
            except Exception as exc:
                decode_errors.append({"format": "parquet", "type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        if csv_path.is_file():
            try:
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(pd.read_csv(csv_path), frame.reset_index(drop=True), check_exact=True)
                csv_read = True
            except Exception as exc:
                decode_errors.append({"format": "csv", "type": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)})
        checks["actual-parquet-values-schema-and-no-index-column"] = parquet_read
        checks["actual-csv-values-schema-and-no-index-column"] = csv_read
        checks["retained-output-entry-unchanged"] = outputs[:1] == outputs_before
        expected_outputs = list(outputs_before)
        for rel, kind in [(normal, "feature_parquet"), (expected_csv, "feature_csv")]:
            p = root / rel
            if p.is_file():
                b = p.read_bytes()
                expected_outputs.append({"relativePath": rel, "bytes": len(b), "sha256": sha(b), "kind": kind})
        checks["manifest-exact-selected-path-kind-size-digest"] = len(expected_outputs) == 3 and outputs == expected_outputs
        expected_schema = copy.deepcopy(schema_before)
        expected_schema["schemaId"] = "capture.analysis_feature_schema/1"
        expected_schema["tables"][normal] = {"featureSchemaVersion": 7, "columns": metadata_before, "rows": 2}
        checks["schema-document-exact-and-existing-fields-retained"] = schema == expected_schema
        checks["unrelated-file-unchanged"] = (root / "keep.dat").read_bytes() == b"KEEP"
        if sentinel:
            checks["global-replacement-sibling-csv-unchanged"] = (root / incorrect_csv).read_bytes() == sentinel_bytes
        elif incorrect_csv != expected_csv:
            checks["no-global-replacement-artifact-created"] = not (root / incorrect_csv).exists()
        try:
            pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(frame, frame_before, check_exact=True)
            frame_unchanged = True
        except AssertionError:
            frame_unchanged = False
        checks["caller-dataframe-and-columns-metadata-unchanged"] = frame_unchanged and metadata == metadata_before
        files = [{"relativePath": str(p.relative_to(root)), "bytes": p.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha(p.read_bytes())}
                 for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()]
        report = {"name": name, "input_relative": relative, "normalized_parquet": normal,
                  "expected_csv": expected_csv, "incorrect_global_replacement_csv": incorrect_csv,
                  "sentinel_installed": sentinel, "checks": checks, "exception": error,
                  "decode_errors": decode_errors, "real_parquet_decoded": parquet_read,
                  "real_csv_decoded": csv_read, "outputs": outputs, "schema": schema,
                  "actual_files": files, "passed": all(checks.values())}
    report["owned_fixture_directory_removed"] = not root.exists()
    report["passed"] = report["passed"] and report["owned_fixture_directory_removed"]
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--expected-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source = args.source.resolve()
    if args.output.exists():
        raise SystemExit("Receipt already exists; inspect it instead of overwriting")
    before = sha(source.read_bytes())
    if before != args.expected_sha256:
        raise SystemExit("Source pin mismatch")
    contract_path = Path(__file__).with_name("frozen-contract.json")
    temp_parent = Path(__file__).with_name("fixtures")
    temp_parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("independent_capture_feature_io", source)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    cases = [receive_case(module, temp_parent, *case) for case in [
        ("ordinary-forward", "features/basic.parquet", False),
        ("ordinary-backslash", "features\\basic.parquet", False),
        ("earlier-stem-with-sibling", "features/band.parquet.metrics.parquet", True),
        ("parent-without-replacement-directory", "capture.parquet/features/rows.parquet", False),
        ("parent-stem-backslash-with-sibling", "capture.parquet\\features\\band.parquet.metrics.parquet", True),
    ]]
    report = {"schema": "hamon.independent-feature-sidecar-receipt.v1",
              "actor": "chatgpt-f0f66340f637/runtime_integration",
              "repository": "Jacob-Met/CaptureSuite", "completed_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "source": str(source), "source_sha256_before": before, "source_sha256_after": sha(source.read_bytes()),
              "source_unchanged": before == sha(source.read_bytes()), "contract_sha256": sha(contract_path.read_bytes()),
              "runner_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "python": platform.python_version(),
              "executable": sys.executable, "pandas": pd.__version__, "pyarrow": pyarrow.__version__,
              "platform": platform.platform(), "parquet_stubbed": False, "native_windows_acceptance": False,
              "author_tests_used": False, "api_scope_note": "Original API always writes CSV; the frozen probe mentioning CSV-disabled behavior is inapplicable and no nonexistent option was invented. All cases use the existing lowercase .parquet contract.",
              "cases": cases, "passed": sum(c["passed"] for c in cases), "total": len(cases),
              "all_owned_fixtures_removed": all(c["owned_fixture_directory_removed"] for c in cases)}
    report["accepted"] = report["passed"] == report["total"] and report["source_unchanged"] and report["all_owned_fixtures_removed"]
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(args.output), "passed": report["passed"], "total": report["total"],
                      "source_unchanged": report["source_unchanged"], "real_parquet": True,
                      "accepted": report["accepted"], "failed_checks": {c["name"]: [k for k, v in c["checks"].items() if not v] for c in cases if not c["passed"]}}))
    return 0 if report["accepted"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Write feature tables as parquet (+ csv mirror)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd


def write_feature_table(
    job_dir: Path,
    relative: str,
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    feature_schema_version: int,
    columns_meta: list[dict[str, Any]],
    schema_doc: dict[str, Any],
    outputs: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    rel = relative.replace("\\", "/")
    path = job_dir / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df.to_parquet(path, index=False)
    csv_rel = rel.replace(".parquet", ".csv")
    df.to_csv(job_dir / csv_rel, index=False)

    import hashlib

    def _add(rel_path: str, kind: str) -> None:
        p = job_dir / rel_path
        data = p.read_bytes()
        outputs.append(
            {
                "relativePath": rel_path.replace("\\", "/"),
                "bytes": len(data),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                "kind": kind,
            }
        )

    _add(rel, "feature_parquet")
    _add(csv_rel, "feature_csv")

    schema_doc.setdefault("schemaId", "capture.analysis_feature_schema/1")
    schema_doc.setdefault("tables", {})
    schema_doc["tables"][rel] = {
        "featureSchemaVersion": feature_schema_version,
        "columns": columns_meta,
        "rows": int(len(df)),
    }
